newsitem.title: CHINA: China sees GDP growth of 9.5 pct in first half.
newsitem.headline: China sees GDP growth of 9.5 pct in first half.

text.p: China expects to record gross domestic product growth (GDP) of 9.5 percent in the first half of this year and a sizzling 10 percent for the whole year, Qiu Xiaohua, chief economist of the State Statistical Bureau said on Friday.
China's GDP rose 9.4 percent in the first quarter, he said.
China has set an official target of eight percent for economic growth this year, trying to cool an economy that still shows signs of possible overheating.
China's GDP soared by 9.7 percent last year.
